podcast.body: Tom Tom Club's first single, released in the summer of 1981, which blended new wave and hip-hop sounds. It became an immediate hit on the British charts, reaching number seven in the UK. "Their first single, wordy rapping hood sounded like both new wave and hip hop and it became an immediate hit on the British charts, reaching number seven in the UK in the summer of 81."
